verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's docs explicitly and repeatedly state that pointing an existing OpenAI SDK to their base_url (https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai) with a DeepInfra API key requires no code changes, only base_url, api_key, and model swap. This is corroborated across multiple doc excerpts describing it as a drop-in replacement. Missing for 10: independent third-party hands-on confirmation beyond vendor docs.
